readme.content:
# mcp-registry

Discover, search, and share Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. Like npm registry, but for MCP.

## Features

- Browse and search MCP servers by category
- Typo-tolerant full-text search powered by Meilisearch
- Submit new servers with manifest validation
- Server detail pages with install commands and capability info
- GitHub OAuth for authenticated submissions

## Prerequisites

- Node.js 22+
- pnpm
- Docker (for PostgreSQL and Meilisearch)

## Quick Start

```bash
# Start services
docker compose up -d

# Install dependencies
pnpm install

# Set up environment
cp .env.example .env

# Push database schema
pnpm db:push

# Start dev server
pnpm dev
```

## Development

```bash
pnpm dev           # Start Next.js dev server
pnpm build         # Production build
pnpm lint          # Run Biome linter
pnpm test          # Run Vitest
pnpm db:studio     # Open Drizzle Studio (DB GUI)
```

## Tech Stack

Next.js 15 | React 19 | Drizzle ORM | PostgreSQL | Meilisearch | Tailwind CSS v4 | Biome | Vitest
